Termux:X11 embedded native engine and adapted Android JNI integration

Upstream: https://github.com/termux/termux-x11
Exact source: fa3a8b430e2896a19f44c99a9cb056254615ae06
Official APK version: 1.03.01-fa3a8b4-06.10.26
License: GNU GPL version 3; see LICENSE.txt. Native dependencies also retain
 their respective upstream licenses in the source repositories.

The full commit appears in the APK's classes.dex. The release body identifies
that same commit. The release tag "nightly" is NOT an immutable source pin:
scripts/x11_assets.py verifies the APK checksum, embedded commit string and
extracted native checksum, and refuses a changed nightly artifact. sources.json
records all observed artifact checksums, source archive checksum, dynamic
libraries and exact submodule gitlinks. The source archive alone is incomplete:
GitHub-generated archives omit submodule contents.

Retrieve the corresponding upstream source, including build scripts and all
pinned dependencies (do not use submodule update --remote):

  git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/termux/termux-x11.git termux-x11-source
  git -C termux-x11-source checkout --detach fa3a8b430e2896a19f44c99a9cb056254615ae06
  git -C termux-x11-source submodule update --init --recursive

Check the submodule commits against sources.json. The exact superproject tree
includes CMake recipes, patches and Gradle/toolchain configuration. Native
sources are under lorie/src/main/cpp. Upstream builds the Xlorie CMake target;
lorie/version.gradle records its NDK version. No native modifications are made
to the extracted libXlorie.so by this project. The upstream engine's auxiliary
TCP knock listener is not disabled by -nolisten tcp: the embedding service must
apply this project's process-wide network guard before loading/starting it.

This project's adapted Java sources, network guard, packaging scripts and build
configuration are also part of the source needed for the combined application.
Its source distribution must correspond to the specific distributed APK.

A license notice and an upstream link alone are NOT a declaration of GPL
compliance. Before distributing binaries, provide recipients equivalent access
to the complete corresponding source (including every pinned submodule, local
modifications and build/install scripts), applicable notices and any required
installation information under GPLv3. Preserve availability for the required
period; do not rely on the moving nightly tag. The distributor remains
responsible for the combined work's licensing and source-conveyance obligations.

Keyboard data is independently packaged from Ubuntu's xkb-data 2.29-2. Its
source URLs, checksums and copyright/license text are in
third_party/xkeyboard-config/. The compact ZIP contains the complete installed
XKB tree rather than only one keyboard layout.
